observations.observation: Dr. Lurie publishing (v2 policy, 2026-07-22): TWO grammars. The agent authors article_body.v1 (CMS-Agent minimal grammar, plain-string bodies only) and the client stores content_item.v1 (zod .strict(), required slug/title/nodes, NO schema_version, supports string | rich_text.v1). At the object_create/object_patch mapping: DROP schema_version, root slug/title/deck/description/taxonomy/seo/image/editorial at the body, carry per-node strategy into private.strategy/intent. Verified: article_body.validate accepts only string bodies; object_validate accepted the same content as rich_text.v1.

Dr. Lurie publish≠release (INTERIM policy §7): object_publish commits the content_item JSON to main with a [skip netlify] marker — free, invisible, no deploy. release_to_production is the ONLY sanctioned production build trigger and ships every accumulated dark commit at once. Rule: batch many publishes, release ONCE per run. Never use trigger_netlify_build (excluded from the agent allowlist). First release_to_production usually returns build_not_confirmed_live — poll deploy_status until deployStatus:ready AND productionConfirmed:true; do not re-release.

Dr. Lurie media reference flip (§6.3, was a build-breaker): a rendered image src MUST be the PUBLIC path /img/{req}/{sha}.ext (or /pdf/{req}/{sha}.pdf). The raw Major-Key blobKey (image/{req}/{sha}.ext) belongs ONLY in *AssetRef / artifact_ref carrier fields — a raw blobKey in any renderable field is a write-blocker (render_image_ref, blocks_write, enforced_live) and 404s/breaks the Astro build. Also blocked in media.src: data: URIs and src/assets repo paths; remote https warns. A PDF can never be the hero. Artifacts are trusted per request id only.

Dr. Lurie taxonomy is an agent-editable registry (tax_drlurie, creation_policy.agents:open). body.taxonomy.category/tags must resolve to ACTIVE terms (unknown terms block write). When a term is missing: prefer an existing term, else extend the registry yourself — object_checkout tax_drlurie + object_patch add_term {kind:'category'|'tag', term:{slug,label}} (term_id t_* minted from slug). Never remove terms to clean up — deprecate_term with merged_into (an active in-kind term, no cycles). reactivate_term is inverse-only (agent_authored:false) — never hand-author it.

Dr. Lurie articles are functional blocks, not blobs (§5.3): one node per persuasion/education beat, each content node tags private.strategy from the 12-value enum (hook·agitation·context·explanation·proof·example·comparison·myth·step·recommendation·resolution·summary) and private.intent from 5 (educate·persuade·reassure·convert·navigate). Offers/CTAs are kind:action nodes, not a strategy value. Node ids are opaque lowercase n_[a-z0-9]+ and must never contain hook/agitation/cta/advert/offer. Live reference: req_agent_niacinamide_barrier_after40 — 7 nodes, hook→context→explanation→proof→myth→step→summary.
